BOOK ONE · LESSON 088

Have you ... yet?

你已经……了吗？

A picture-based lesson on the present perfect tense with 'yet'. Four illustrations each introduce a 'Have you ... yet? / When did ...?' question-and-answer pair (met Mrs. Jones, the boss left, had breakfast, found her pen). A table of irregular verbs (buy, find, get, have, hear, leave, lose, make, meet, send, sweep, tell) reinforces the past and past-participle forms. Written exercises A (write questions and negative answers from past-simple sentences) and B (write 'Have you ... yet?' questions with answers and when-questions) are transcribed from the textbook. Workbook practice covers completing 'Has he finished it yet?' dialogues and personal questions. Grammar exercises practise giving present-perfect replies to imperatives and answering 'and' questions partially.

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。

Listen to the recording and answer the questions in the four pictures.

Have you met Mrs. Jones yet?
Yes, I have.
When did you meet her?
I met her two weeks ago.

第1幅：你见过琼斯太太了吗？是的，我见过。你什么时候见到她的？我两周前见到的她。

Has the boss left yet?
Yes, he has.
When did he leave?
He left ten minutes ago.

第2幅：老板走了吗？是的，他走了。他什么时候走的？他十分钟前走的。

Have you had breakfast yet?
Yes, we have.
When did you have it?
We had it at half past seven.

第3幅：你们吃过早饭了吗？是的，我们吃了。你们什么时候吃的？我们七点半吃的。

Has she found her pen yet?
Yes, she has.
When did she find it?
She found it an hour ago.

第4幅：她找到她的钢笔了吗？是的，她找到了。她什么时候找到的？她一小时前找到的。

Study these verbs.
记住以下不规则动词的过去式和过去分词。

buy — bought — bought
find — found — found
get — got — got
have — had — had
hear — heard — heard
leave — left — left
lose — lost — lost
make — made — made
meet — met — met
send — sent — sent
sweep — swept — swept
tell — told — told

Irregular verbs with their past and past-participle forms.

Written exercises A — Write questions and answers

Write questions and answers. 模仿例句就以下句子提问，并作出否定的回答。

Example:
He bought a house last year.
QUESTION: Did he buy a house last year?
NEGATIVE: He didn't buy a house last year.

For each sentence write a past-simple question and a negative answer, following the example.

Suggested model answers following the printed example pattern.

Written exercises B — Write questions and answers

Write questions and answers. 模仿例句提问并回答。

Example:
they / buy a new house / two weeks ago
Have they bought a new house yet?
Yes, they have already bought a new house.
When did they buy a new house?
They bought a new house two weeks ago.

For each set of prompts write a 'Have you ... yet?' question with a yes answer and a when-question with a past-simple answer, following the example.

Suggested model answers following the printed example pattern.
